primary_goal: Guide visitors to featured promotions, key product categories, and product detail pages to initiate a purchase.

friction_points.issue: Misleading product concepts and unreleased items listed with prices create severe trust issues.
friction_points.evidence: Products such as 'iPhone 18 Pro' with price '1449,- €' under 'Aktuell beliebt' and 'GTA VI' under 'Am häufigsten gekauft'.

friction_points.issue: Duplicated promotional banners clutter the page and increase visual fatigue on mobile.
friction_points.evidence: The 'myMediaMarkt' registration banner appears in image slice 8 and is repeated again right below the newsletter box in image slice 9.

friction_points.issue: Promotional campaign CTAs have low visual prominence due to thin outlined styling and generic phrasing.
friction_points.evidence: 'Zur Aktion' buttons on hero banner and coupon cards use low-contrast outline buttons instead of solid, high-converting primary buttons.

friction_points.issue: Excessive vertical length caused by massive, uncollapsible legal text disclaimers at the bottom of the page.
friction_points.evidence: Image slices 12 through 20 consist of continuous dense legal footnote paragraphs directly rendered on the mobile page body.

friction_points.issue: Lack of prominent customer review aggregate badges or independent trust seals in the mobile hero area.
friction_points.evidence: No Trusted Shops, TÜV, or overall store rating stars visible near the top fold or primary deal area.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we remove duplicate promotional banners, then engagement with lower homepage sections will increase because visitors will experience less repetitive cognitive clutter.
hypotheses.change: Consolidate myMediaMarkt banners so it only appears once on the homepage.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we replace outlined 'Zur Aktion' buttons with solid high-contrast CTA buttons featuring action copy like 'Jetzt Rabatte sichern', then campaign click-through rate will increase because the action step is visually clearer.
hypotheses.change: Redesign banner CTAs to solid filled buttons with clear value-driven text.

hypotheses.hypothesis: If we collapse the lengthy legal disclaimers into an expandable 'Rechtliche Hinweise' accordion, then footer usability will improve because mobile scroll fatigue is drastically reduced.
hypotheses.change: Wrap footnote disclaimers (1-48) inside an expandable accordion component.

quick_wins: Remove duplicate myMediaMarkt banner in section 9.
Fix mock product data (iPhone 18 Pro, MacBook Pro M6) to reflect real available products.
uncertainties: Whether the unreleased product listings (iPhone 18 Pro, GTA VI) are part of a staging environment or intentional placeholder test data.
Mobile user drop-off rate at different scroll depth percentages.
